name: Terrace of the Lions
text: A monument dedicated to Apollo by the Naxians ca. 600 BCE, the "Terrace of the Lions"originally had nine to twelve squatting lions along the Sacred Way. Seven remain in situ today..

depictions.name: Terrace of the Lions
depictions.text: Delos#Landmarks The Terrace of the Lions is a monument of nine marble lion statues located north of the Sanctuary of Apollo on the island of Delos, Greece.
